description:
Planning-only coverage task for lib/zaq/engine/history/facts.ex missed lines 52, 53, 57, 83, 120, 139, 149. Exclusive test ownership: edit ONLY test/zaq/engine/history/strategy_test.exs. No production/support/docs changes; no tests or Git changes in this planning task.

Functional specifications and tests to add before implementation (all through public Facts.for_capture/1 or Facts.new/1, exact observable results):
1. Line 52: for_capture/1 with valid base attrs plus thread_id: "   " (or "") returns {:error, :invalid_history_facts}; thread is rejected before root validation. Existing capture property exercises only valid alphanumeric threads.
2. Line 53: for_capture/1 with nonempty thread_id: "reply-1" but root invalid (e.g. channel_config_id: 0) returns {:error, :invalid_history_facts} propagated from new/1; assert no successful capture. Distinguishes root failure from invalid thread and demonstrates unresolved-thread allowance does not bypass identity checks. A second optional case with kind: :unknown checks preservation of {:error, :unsupported_strategy} rather than normalizing failures.
3. Line 57: for_capture(nil) returns {:error, :invalid_history_facts}; exercises non-map guard independently of invalid map content.
4. Line 83: new(nil) returns {:error, :invalid_history_facts}; distinct non-map guard; existing invalid-map assertions do not reach it.
5. Line 120: new/1 with valid replicated base (provider: "email:imap", channel_id: "mail-thread", kind: :replicated, channel_config_id: 12, actor_person_id: 5, recipient_person_ids: [7], thread_id: "reply-1", parent: nil) returns {:ok, %Facts{kind: :replicated, thread_id: "reply-1", parent: nil}}; contrasts existing Shared/Direct missing-parent rejection. This is policy validation, not authorization or recipient proof.
6. Line 139: new/1 with valid Shared root coordinates, thread_id: "reply-1", parent: %{id: Ecto.UUID.generate()} (a map, not a Transcript) returns {:error, :parent_scope_mismatch}; identity and strategy must pass so malformed parent reaches catch-all. Optionally integer/atom parent to prove fail-closed; do not add speculative generative garbage tests.
7. Line 149: new/1 with replicated thread, matching Transcript parent scope (parent_id: nil, strategy: "replicated", provider: "email:imap", channel_config_id: 12, external_channel_id: "mail-thread", valid UUID) but owner_person_id: nil and permission_resource_type: "person_history" returns {:error, :parent_scope_mismatch}. Repeat with positive owner_person_id: 7 but wrong permission_resource_type (e.g. "channel_history") to check both boolean operands; positive owner plus "person_history" is the control returning {:ok, facts}. The root matching fields must match exactly or the guard short-circuits before line 149. The resource ID may remain a deterministic channel-history fixture value because replicated matching_resource?/3 only checks owner positivity and resource type; no persistence or permission grant is conferred.

Fixture/helper plan: reuse existing async ExUnit.Case + ExUnitProperties module, private facts(overrides) and parent(strategy, overrides) helpers in strategy_test.exs. Use base overrides for replicated scenarios and parent("replicated", %{provider: "email:imap", external_channel_id: "mail-thread", owner_person_id: ..., permission_resource_type: ...}); existing helper generates a valid UUID and defaults channel_config_id 12 and nil parent_id. Keep expected fields explicit. Do not add fixtures, new support modules, DB setup or production test hooks. Assertions pattern-match exact error atoms or relevant Facts fields, and compare against a valid control when appropriate; no assertion against internal/private calls or mere non-nil values. Retain existing tests and assertions.

Mocking and isolation: Facts is pure; no Mox, NodeRouter stub, external network, Repo, SQL Sandbox, application env mutation, process, timers, global state or concurrent workers. Preserve async: true; no sleeps/polling. No E2E: no UI journey or changed behavior. Property assessment: existing property covers valid unresolved Shared threads and another property covers recipient permutation target invariance. These missed guard branches are finite structural cases and one deterministic replicated-parent invariant, so focused examples are sufficient; do not introduce a redundant property merely to increase line coverage. If scope expands to arbitrary parent/scope combinations or malformed inputs as a contractual invariant, consider a bounded StreamData property with guaranteed valid root coordinates and varying parent fields, plus concrete examples.

Action reuse assessment: not applicable — only tests of existing pure Facts validation/strategy selection; no executable operation, Action, tool, workflow Step, permission, dispatch boundary or runtime dependency changes. Facts module documentation identifies normalized facts as pure policy inputs, not authentication or persistence authority. Existing tests and Engine service policy remain authoritative; no documentation edits planned.

Validation for later implementer only: run isolated `mix test test/zaq/engine/history/strategy_test.exs` and `mix q` through Context Mode, inspect diff, then use a fresh coverage report as required by WORKFLOW_AGENT Phase 6 to verify all seven line hits and whole-file coverage, without weakening existing tests. If coverage still reports missing lines, confirm exact source revision/instrumentation and inspect which guard short-circuited; in particular line 149 requires a matching Transcript scope and line 53 requires valid thread plus invalid root. Follow post-review coverage handoff and final `mix precommit` gate when applicable. No tests or gates run in planning phase.

Unreachable blockers: none identified through these public APIs; `for_capture/1` deliberately clears parent/thread before validating root, so do not try to hit parent mismatch through for_capture. Parent must be a Transcript struct and match all scope fields to reach replicated resource check. No dependencies: one independent Engine History test surface, one issue. Documentation to update: none for test-only coverage; record exceptions/coverage in Beadwork/PR if later measurement differs.
title: [zaq-w99] [coverage] Cover Engine History Facts validation and parent guards
